plan.title: Explore data structure and annotations
plan.description: Write scratch.py to examine: (1) image count and sizes in data/train/images/, (2) annotations.json structure — number of annotations, categories, images, (3) distribution of annotations per image, (4) distribution of annotations per category, (5) category names and IDs, (6) check for 'corrected' field, (7) examine data/products/ structure and data/metadata.json.
plan.success_criteria: Clear understanding of data dimensions, category distribution, image sizes, reference product availability logged to stdout

plan.title: Verify package versions and install pinned ultralytics
plan.description: In scratch.py, check installed versions of torch, torchvision, timm, ultralytics. Install ultralytics==8.1.0 if not already installed. Verify CUDA availability and GPU type.
plan.success_criteria: ultralytics==8.1.0 confirmed, torch/torchvision/CUDA working, GPU detected

plan.title: Create 90/10 stratified train/val split
plan.description: Write a script to split annotations.json into train_split.json and val_split.json. Use seed=42, split by image. Stratify by store section (Egg, Frokost, Knekkebrod, Varmedrikker — infer from image filenames or folder structure). Ensure ~223 train / ~25 val images. Output both files in COCO format with all annotations for each image staying together.
plan.success_criteria: Two valid COCO-format JSON files created, proportional section representation in val, counts verified

plan.title: Write evaluation function
plan.description: Implement an evaluation function using pycocotools that computes: (1) detection_mAP@0.5 — treat all predictions as single class, (2) classification_mAP@0.5 — use actual category_ids, (3) val_score = 0.7 * detection_mAP + 0.3 * classification_mAP. Test with dummy predictions to verify it works.
plan.success_criteria: Function returns correct val_score components, tested with dummy data

plan.title: Convert COCO annotations to YOLO format
plan.description: Write a conversion script that creates YOLO-format label files from the COCO train_split.json and val_split.json. Create proper directory structure (images/train, images/val, labels/train, labels/val) and a dataset YAML file. Handle the 357 categories (0-356).
plan.success_criteria: YOLO dataset directory created with correct label files, YAML config written

plan.title: YOLOv8n baseline with nc=357 at 640px
plan.hypothesis: A YOLOv8n baseline achieves val_score > 0.15 with 357 classes at 640px resolution
plan.description: Train YOLOv8n on the train split with nc=357, imgsz=640, epochs=100, batch=16. Evaluate on val split using the evaluation function. Record val_score, detection_mAP, classification_mAP, and training time.
plan.success_criteria: Baseline val_score recorded, model trains without errors

plan.title: YOLOv8s with nc=357 at 640px
plan.hypothesis: YOLOv8s improves val_score by 5+ points over YOLOv8n
plan.description: Train YOLOv8s with same settings as baseline. Compare val_score.
plan.success_criteria: val_score improvement over YOLOv8n recorded

plan.title: YOLOv8m with nc=357 at 640px
plan.hypothesis: YOLOv8m further improves val_score over YOLOv8s
plan.description: Train YOLOv8m with nc=357, imgsz=640, epochs=150, appropriate batch size. Evaluate and compare.
plan.success_criteria: val_score compared to previous models

plan.title: YOLOv8l with nc=357 at 1280px
plan.hypothesis: Larger model + higher resolution significantly improves detection on dense shelves
plan.description: Train YOLOv8l with nc=357, imgsz=1280, epochs=200, batch=4 (or 8 with gradient accumulation). Use close_mosaic=50. Evaluate and compare.
plan.success_criteria: val_score improvement over previous best

plan.title: YOLOv8x with nc=357 at 1280px
plan.hypothesis: YOLOv8x at 1280px is the best single YOLO model for this task
plan.description: Train YOLOv8x with nc=357, imgsz=1280, epochs=300, batch=4, close_mosaic=50. This is expected to be the strongest single YOLO model. Record all metrics.
plan.success_criteria: val_score recorded, compared to YOLOv8l

plan.title: YOLOv8x nc=1 (detection-only) at 1280px
plan.hypothesis: A single-class detector achieves higher detection_mAP than nc=357 since it doesn't need to distinguish classes
plan.description: Convert annotations to single-class (all category_id=0). Train YOLOv8x with nc=1, imgsz=1280, epochs=300. Evaluate detection_mAP@0.5 only. Compare detection recall to nc=357 model.
plan.success_criteria: detection_mAP improvement over nc=357 model quantified

plan.title: Explore reference product images for embedding gallery
plan.description: Examine data/products/ directory: count products with reference images, image types available (main.jpg, front.jpg, etc.), image quality/sizes. Cross-reference with category IDs in annotations. Determine coverage — how many of the 357 categories have reference images?
plan.success_criteria: Complete mapping of category_id to available reference images, coverage statistics

plan.title: Build DINOv2-base embedding pipeline
plan.hypothesis: DINOv2-base embeddings can distinguish grocery products via kNN on reference images
plan.description: Implement: (1) Load DINOv2-base from torch hub or timm, (2) Extract embeddings for all reference product images → gallery, (3) Extract embeddings for training annotation crops, (4) Test kNN classification accuracy on val split crops (using ground truth boxes). Measure top-1 and top-5 accuracy.
plan.success_criteria: kNN classification accuracy on val crops measured, gallery built successfully

plan.title: Two-stage pipeline: nc=1 YOLO + DINOv2 classification
plan.hypothesis: nc=1 detector + DINOv2 classification achieves higher val_score than nc=357 YOLO alone
plan.description: Combine the nc=1 YOLOv8x detector with DINOv2-base kNN classification. For each detection, crop from original resolution image, extract DINOv2 embedding, find nearest neighbor in gallery. Evaluate full val_score.
plan.success_criteria: val_score exceeds best nc=357 YOLO model

plan.title: Augment gallery with training crops
plan.hypothesis: Adding training annotation crops to the DINOv2 gallery improves classification accuracy
plan.description: Extract crops from all training images using ground truth boxes. Compute DINOv2 embeddings. Add to gallery alongside reference images (with configurable weighting). Re-evaluate kNN classification on val split.
plan.success_criteria: Classification mAP improvement measured

plan.title: Tune kNN hyperparameters
plan.hypothesis: Optimal k and temperature differ from defaults and can improve classification by 2+ points
plan.description: Sweep kNN parameters on val split: k=[1,3,5,7,11], temperature=[0.01,0.05,0.1,0.5], distance weighting vs majority voting. Use ground truth val boxes to isolate classification quality. Also test cosine vs L2 distance.
plan.success_criteria: Best kNN configuration identified with measurable improvement

plan.title: NMS and score threshold tuning
plan.hypothesis: Tuning NMS IoU threshold and confidence threshold improves detection mAP on dense shelves
plan.description: Using the best YOLO model, sweep: NMS IoU threshold [0.4, 0.5, 0.6, 0.7, 0.8], confidence threshold [0.05, 0.1, 0.15, 0.2, 0.25, 0.3]. Evaluate val_score for each combination.
plan.success_criteria: Optimal thresholds found, val_score improvement quantified

plan.title: Test-time augmentation (TTA)
plan.hypothesis: TTA improves detection mAP by 1-2 points
plan.description: Run inference with augment=True on the best YOLO model. Compare val_score with and without TTA. Measure inference time increase.
plan.success_criteria: TTA impact on val_score and inference time measured

plan.title: SAHI-style tiled inference
plan.hypothesis: Tiled inference significantly improves detection of small products, boosting detection_mAP by 3+ points
plan.description: Implement sliced inference: split each image into overlapping tiles (e.g., 1280x1280 with stride 960), run YOLO on each tile + full image, merge detections with WBF. Evaluate val_score. Measure inference time per image.
plan.success_criteria: val_score improvement from tiling quantified, inference time within 300s budget

plan.title: RT-DETR-l training
plan.hypothesis: RT-DETR-l provides different error patterns from YOLO, useful for ensemble
plan.description: Train RT-DETR-l with nc=357, imgsz=1280, epochs=200. Evaluate standalone val_score. Compare detection patterns to YOLOv8x — look for complementary strengths.
plan.success_criteria: RT-DETR-l val_score recorded, error analysis compared to YOLO

plan.title: WBF ensemble: YOLOv8x + RT-DETR-l
plan.hypothesis: Ensembling YOLO + RT-DETR with WBF improves val_score by 2+ points over best single model
plan.description: Combine predictions from YOLOv8x and RT-DETR-l using Weighted Boxes Fusion. Tune WBF parameters (iou_threshold, skip_box_threshold, weights). Evaluate val_score.
plan.success_criteria: Ensemble val_score exceeds best single model

plan.title: Confidence-gated classification: YOLO classes vs DINOv2
plan.hypothesis: Using YOLO class predictions when confident and DINOv2 when uncertain improves classification mAP
plan.description: For each detection, compare YOLO class confidence vs DINOv2 embedding similarity. Use a threshold to decide which classification to trust. Sweep threshold on val split. Also try: always use DINOv2, always use YOLO, weighted combination.
plan.success_criteria: Best gating strategy identified, val_score improvement measured

plan.title: DINOv2-large vs DINOv2-base comparison
plan.hypothesis: DINOv2-large embeddings improve classification mAP by 3+ points over base
plan.description: Load DINOv2-large (ViT-L/14), rebuild gallery, re-evaluate kNN classification on val split using ground truth boxes. Compare to DINOv2-base. Check model size for submission budget.
plan.success_criteria: Classification accuracy improvement quantified, model size checked against 420MB budget

plan.title: Fine-tune projection head on DINOv2 embeddings
plan.hypothesis: A trained projection head on frozen DINOv2 features improves classification by learning product-specific distinctions
plan.description: Freeze DINOv2-base, train a 2-layer MLP projection head using ArcFace or contrastive loss on training crops + reference images. Use the projected embeddings for kNN. Evaluate on val split.
plan.success_criteria: Classification mAP improvement over raw DINOv2 embeddings

plan.title: YOLOv8x at 1280px with extended training (500 epochs)
plan.hypothesis: Longer training with 357 classes benefits from more epochs due to the extreme multi-class nature
plan.description: Train YOLOv8x with nc=357, imgsz=1280, epochs=500, close_mosaic=100, patience=100. Compare to 300-epoch run.
plan.success_criteria: val_score improvement from longer training quantified

plan.title: Training with label smoothing
plan.hypothesis: Label smoothing helps with noisy labels and visually similar categories
plan.description: Train YOLOv8x with label_smoothing=0.1, same other settings as best config. Compare val_score.
plan.success_criteria: Impact of label smoothing on val_score measured

plan.title: Multi-crop DINOv2 inference
plan.hypothesis: Averaging embeddings from multiple crop variations improves classification robustness
plan.description: For each detection, extract 4 crop variations: (1) original box, (2) center 80% crop, (3) box with 10% padding, (4) slight brightness augmentation. Average DINOv2 embeddings before kNN lookup. Evaluate on val split.
plan.success_criteria: Classification mAP improvement over single-crop

plan.title: Per-category adaptive classification thresholds
plan.hypothesis: Setting per-category confidence thresholds improves classification mAP by avoiding confident wrong predictions
plan.description: On val split, compute optimal confidence threshold per category. For categories where DINOv2 is unreliable, fall back to category_id=0 (doesn't hurt detection score). Implement threshold learning on train split, evaluate on val.
plan.success_criteria: val_score improvement from adaptive thresholds

plan.title: Co-occurrence priors from store sections
plan.hypothesis: Using store section context (Egg, Frokost, etc.) as a prior narrows classification candidates and improves accuracy
plan.description: Build category-to-section mapping from training data. At inference, first classify the image's section (or use spatial clustering), then restrict kNN search to products from that section. Evaluate on val split.
plan.success_criteria: Classification mAP improvement from section-based filtering

plan.title: YOLOv8x nc=1 at 1280px with tiling + DINOv2 classification
plan.hypothesis: Combining the best detection setup (nc=1 + tiling) with best classification (DINOv2) maximizes val_score
plan.description: Run nc=1 YOLOv8x with SAHI tiling for detection, then classify all detections with the best DINOv2 pipeline. This combines maximum detection recall with embedding-based classification.
plan.success_criteria: val_score exceeds all previous configurations

plan.title: RT-DETR-x training
plan.hypothesis: RT-DETR-x outperforms RT-DETR-l and provides a stronger ensemble partner
plan.description: Train RT-DETR-x with nc=357, imgsz=1280, epochs=200. Compare to RT-DETR-l standalone and in ensemble with YOLO.
plan.success_criteria: RT-DETR-x val_score and ensemble contribution measured

plan.title: Three-model WBF ensemble
plan.hypothesis: Adding a third model to the ensemble further improves val_score
plan.description: Combine YOLOv8x + RT-DETR-l + YOLOv8l (or YOLOv8x at different resolution) with WBF. Tune ensemble weights. Check if inference time fits within 300s budget.
plan.success_criteria: Three-model ensemble val_score exceeds two-model ensemble

plan.title: Progressive resolution training
plan.hypothesis: Training at 640 first then fine-tuning at 1280 is faster and potentially better than training at 1280 throughout
plan.description: Train YOLOv8x at 640 for 100 epochs, then continue at 1280 for 200 epochs. Compare val_score and total training time to direct 1280 training.
plan.success_criteria: val_score and training time compared to direct high-res training

plan.title: Copy-paste augmentation from reference images
plan.hypothesis: Synthetic augmentation using reference product photos improves rare category detection
plan.description: Implement copy-paste augmentation: paste reference product images (with perspective warps, lighting adjustments) onto shelf backgrounds. Focus on rare categories (<5 training examples). Retrain YOLOv8x with augmented data.
plan.success_criteria: val_score improvement, especially for rare categories

plan.title: Corrected annotation weighting
plan.hypothesis: Upweighting corrected annotations improves model quality
plan.description: Identify annotations with corrected=True. Duplicate these in training data (2x or 3x). Retrain and compare val_score.
plan.success_criteria: Impact of annotation weighting on val_score measured

plan.title: CLAHE preprocessing for inference
plan.hypothesis: Contrast enhancement helps detect products in poorly lit shelf areas
plan.description: Apply CLAHE (Contrast Limited Adaptive Histogram Equalization) to images before inference. Compare detection results with and without preprocessing on val split.
plan.success_criteria: Impact on val_score measured

plan.title: Patch-level DINOv2 matching
plan.hypothesis: Using patch tokens instead of CLS token improves classification for partially occluded products
plan.description: Extract DINOv2 patch tokens for both query crops and gallery entries. Implement patch-level matching (e.g., average of top-k most similar patches). Compare to CLS-token-only approach on val split.
plan.success_criteria: Classification accuracy comparison with CLS-only approach

plan.title: Pseudo-labeling at test time
plan.hypothesis: Using high-confidence test predictions to augment the gallery improves classification of repeated products
plan.description: Implement two-pass inference: (1) Run detector + classifier on all test images, (2) Add high-confidence crops (score > 0.85) to DINOv2 gallery, (3) Re-classify all detections with augmented gallery. Simulate on val split.
plan.success_criteria: val_score improvement from pseudo-labeling measured

plan.title: INT8 quantization of YOLO model
plan.hypothesis: INT8 quantization reduces model size by ~50% with <1 mAP loss
plan.description: Export best YOLO model to ONNX with INT8 quantization. Benchmark val_score vs FP16. Measure size reduction and inference speed change.
plan.success_criteria: Size reduction and accuracy tradeoff quantified

plan.title: DINOv2-large with INT8 YOLO to fit budget
plan.hypothesis: INT8 YOLO + FP16 DINOv2-large fits within 420MB and outperforms FP16 YOLO + DINOv2-base
plan.description: Combine INT8-quantized YOLOv8x (~65MB) with DINOv2-large FP16 (~300MB). Total ~370MB. Evaluate val_score vs current best configuration.
plan.success_criteria: Configuration fits in 420MB and achieves higher val_score

plan.title: Rectangular inference mode
plan.hypothesis: rect=True preserves aspect ratio better and improves detection on non-square images
plan.description: Run inference with rect=True on the best YOLO model. Compare val_score to square inference.
plan.success_criteria: Impact of rectangular inference measured

plan.title: Embedding-weighted box fusion
plan.hypothesis: Using DINOv2 embedding agreement as a signal during box fusion improves ensemble quality
plan.description: When merging overlapping boxes from multiple models via WBF, compute DINOv2 embedding similarity between the crops. Weight boxes higher when models agree on the embedding. Evaluate on val split.
plan.success_criteria: val_score improvement over standard WBF

plan.title: Train YOLOv8x at 1920px resolution
plan.hypothesis: Even higher resolution captures more product detail for dense shelves
plan.description: Train YOLOv8x at imgsz=1920 with batch=2 and gradient accumulation. May need to reduce epochs. Evaluate val_score vs 1280.
plan.success_criteria: val_score comparison with 1280 resolution

plan.title: Class-balanced focal loss training
plan.hypothesis: Focal loss with class balancing improves rare category detection
plan.description: Train YOLOv8x with focal loss and class frequency-based weighting. Compare classification mAP for rare vs common categories against standard training.
plan.success_criteria: Rare category classification improvement measured

plan.title: Gallery composition ablation
plan.hypothesis: The optimal mix of reference images vs training crops in the gallery differs from equal weighting
plan.description: Test gallery compositions: (1) reference images only, (2) training crops only, (3) references weighted 3x, (4) training crops weighted 2x, (5) equal weight. Evaluate classification mAP for each.
plan.success_criteria: Best gallery composition identified

plan.title: Spatial context features for classification
plan.hypothesis: Including surrounding shelf context in the crop improves classification of ambiguous products
plan.description: For each detection, extract two crops: (1) tight box, (2) box with 30% context padding. Concatenate or average their DINOv2 embeddings. Compare classification accuracy to tight-crop-only.
plan.success_criteria: Impact of context features on classification measured

plan.title: Soft-NMS for single model inference
plan.hypothesis: Soft-NMS retains more true positives than hard NMS on dense shelves
plan.description: Replace hard NMS with Soft-NMS (Gaussian or linear decay) for single model inference. Sweep sigma parameter. Evaluate val_score.
plan.success_criteria: Soft-NMS vs hard NMS comparison on val_score

plan.title: Close mosaic timing sweep
plan.hypothesis: Optimal close_mosaic value differs from default 50 for this dense detection task
plan.description: Train YOLOv8x with close_mosaic values [25, 50, 100, 150] (out of total epochs). Compare val_score.
plan.success_criteria: Optimal close_mosaic value identified

plan.title: ONNX export and inference verification
plan.description: Export the best YOLO model and DINOv2 model to ONNX format. Verify inference produces identical results to PyTorch. Check ONNX opset ≤ 20. Measure ONNX inference speed.
plan.success_criteria: ONNX models produce matching predictions, opset verified

plan.title: Build complete submission run.py
plan.description: Write run.py that: (1) loads ONNX/PT models, (2) runs detection (with tiling if beneficial), (3) runs DINOv2 classification on crops, (4) applies confidence gating, (5) outputs predictions.json in correct format. Use only allowed imports (pathlib, json, no os/sys).
plan.success_criteria: run.py produces valid predictions.json, uses only allowed imports

plan.title: End-to-end inference timing test
plan.hypothesis: Complete pipeline runs within 300s on val images (extrapolated to full test set)
plan.description: Time the complete run.py pipeline on val images. Extrapolate to full test set. If over budget, identify bottlenecks and optimize (reduce tiles, use smaller model, batch processing).
plan.success_criteria: Estimated total inference time < 300s for ~248 images

plan.title: Submission size verification
plan.description: Package all submission files, verify total uncompressed size < 420MB, max 3 weight files. Check all file extensions are allowed (.py, .json, .yaml, .cfg, .pt, .onnx, .safetensors, .npy).
plan.success_criteria: Submission package meets all size and format constraints

plan.title: Optimize inference pipeline for speed
plan.hypothesis: Batched DINOv2 inference and optimized crop extraction can reduce total time by 30%+
plan.description: Profile the inference pipeline. Batch DINOv2 crop processing instead of one-by-one. Use efficient image loading. Pre-allocate tensors. Minimize CPU-GPU transfers.
plan.success_criteria: Measurable inference speedup while maintaining val_score

plan.title: Final configuration sweep
plan.hypothesis: Combining all best individual improvements yields the highest val_score
plan.description: Combine the best settings from all experiments: best model(s), best resolution, best tiling config, best DINOv2 variant, best kNN params, best thresholds, best gallery composition. Run full evaluation on val split.
plan.success_criteria: Final val_score is the highest achieved across all experiments

plan.title: Clean up and document final configuration
plan.description: Document the final best configuration: model architecture, training hyperparameters, inference settings, val_score breakdown. Clean up code. Prepare clear instructions for human operator to retrain on full dataset.
plan.success_criteria: Complete documentation of best config with reproducible training commands
